items.statement: The β1 fluorene-related dihedral magnitudes are approximately 87.11° for MeACFy and 88.02° for TfACFy.
items.expected_result: Compare the reproducibly defined spiro-junction interplanar angles to the reported pair. Identify both ring atom sets and the angle convention; the source does not supply atom quadruplets. An unrelated four-anchor torsion must not be passed off as the same angle. β1 is not applicable to MeAC and TfAC.
items.expected: Nearly orthogonal spiro-junction planes for MeACFy and TfACFy, with explicit atom sets, source comparison and any convention limitation; not applicable for the non-spiro pair.

items.statement: HOMO density is mainly on the acridine-type donor for all four compounds. The source specifically identifies the phenanthrimidazole/π-bridge LUMO pattern in MeAC and MeACFy, whereas TfAC and TfACFy shift LUMO density toward the CF3-substituted short-axis aryl system (main pp.2–3 and Fig.2). Do not impose methyl-like core/bridge dominance on the CF3 pair.
items.expected_result: Report named-fragment HOMO/LUMO localization for every compound, distinguishing acridine, π-bridge, phenanthrimidazole core, short-axis aryl/substituent and fluorene where present. Compare the molecule-specific patterns to the source and disclose partition limitations. A quantitative Cartesian-axis projection is not required; fragment populations are not such a projection.
items.expected: Donor-dominated HOMOs and molecule-specific acceptor-side LUMO localization consistent with main pp.2–3/Fig.2; do not hide CF3 short-aryl density by assigning it to an undefined core.
